%FactionQuest_LastLord_Chapter01_Step01_:
Since awakening on the world of Saiadha, Consul Tyabana has felt out of sorts. Maybe it was the eons slumbering between the stars... or maybe it was the shock of Saiadha.
The ancient maps on Auriga foretold a world of sand and Dust, but the ocean world was anything but desert. Wild seas, windswept isles, dangers in the deeps.
Aside from her trusty advisor, Leofric, and her most loyal champion, the rest of the party are mere husks, soulless automatons masquerading as Lords.
Much must be done before Tyabana can even begin to grapple with the question of the Lords' accursed nature...the one thing they couldn't leave behind on Auriga.
